title: Create PR for iteration 01.2
description:
## Objective
One PR for the iteration, targeting the base branch.

## Implementation
1. Base branch is in `.devmeta/increments/increment-01-zmf/base-branch`.
2. `gh pr create --repo juansita/devmeta` — without --repo it targets upstream and fails.
3. Body: the three diagrams, the new CLAUDE.md, and how to verify.

## Tests
Run: `cd slides && npm run build` and `cd slides && npm run slides` before opening the PR.
acceptance_criteria: PR open against the base branch, build green
